comment: Read at commit 1fc62fa, the only commit carrying the installed 2.0.4. The peak readout at Speck.cpp:383 prints stats->peakx, which Stats::calculate fills with the index of the loudest bin rather than a frequency, while the label beside it reads Peak f. The analysis runs as soon as either input is patched; the ON button toggles a forceOff flag that is cleared whenever both inputs are pulled out. The two pass-through jacks copy the input voltage without touching it, one channel only, so a polyphonic cable comes out as a single channel. Nothing here is polyphonic and the plugin adds no context menu items.
